name: Magnalien
look: a great silver mothership with a ring of coloured running lights, a ridged dome with one huge green eye, a rainbow halo, four little docked saucer pods and a rainbow tractor beam
entry: A mothership that carries the little saucers it was formed from docked round its rim. It hovers silently over fields at night, and whatever its rainbow beam touches is never quite where it was left in the morning.
how: Evolve a CobbleEffortian Magneton at level 45. It learns Psychic when it evolves.
